certified_absence.required_semantics: negative_evidence is permitted only with independently validated target-absence certification
certified_absence.calls_on_resolved_truth: count resolved biological truth rows with negative_evidence
certified_absence.false_count: among certified absence calls on resolved truth, count rows whose biological truth is visit_event
certified_absence.missed_visit_rate: resolved true visits called certified absent / all resolved true visits; 0 when denominator is 0

forced_absence.required_semantics: forced_absence_call is an intentionally unsafe comparator and never certified biological negative evidence
forced_absence.calls_on_resolved_truth: count resolved biological truth rows with forced_absence_call
forced_absence.false_count: among forced absence calls on resolved truth, count rows whose biological truth is visit_event
forced_absence.missed_visit_rate: resolved true visits forced absent / all resolved true visits; 0 when denominator is 0

hard_boundaries: unresolved biological truth is excluded from biological accuracy denominators
censored predictions cannot carry forced or certified absence calls
forced and certified absence calls are mutually exclusive
under the fixed V15-v2 no-A-minus strategy, a certified absence call is not expected from the default system; any occurrence requires explicit independent certification provenance
held-out results cannot change these formulas
